items.title: Public research edition 0.6.1
items.description: GeoPackage with 46 registered tables, four district geographies, core CSV tables, documentation, quality flags, examples and the R source package. Provider source geometries are linked upstream.

items.title: Complete tabular edition
items.description: CSV tables for all four geographies, full monthly and annual climate panels, railway series, geographical modules, dictionaries and source links. No GIS software required.

items.title: Historical map atlas
items.description: 42 thematic maps in 39 original-resolution PNG figures, with the gallery catalogue, explanatory captions and source documentation.

items.title: histCzechia 0.2.1
items.description: Companion R source package. Reads public edition 0.6.1 and the earlier research releases; installation and examples are included. Not on CRAN.

items.title: District core: judicial districts 1930
items.description: 444 source fields for 330 districts, excluding the separately supplied climate normals.

items.title: Climate normals: judicial districts 1930
items.description: 18 CRU-derived normal fields, plus geography and district ID. Join explicitly to the core to recover all 462 fields.

items.title: Monthly climate: judicial districts 1930
items.description: 150,480 district-months for 1901–1938; ten climate variables and station-support diagnostics.

items.title: Full variable dictionary
items.description: 2,259 documented fields across the retained public tables; the browser dictionary covers the 462-field main district record.

items.title: Getting started
items.description: File guide, district geographies, QGIS instructions, explicit joins and Python/R examples.

items.title: Methods and quality
items.description: Definitions, geographical coverage, known qualifications, display masks and the version 0.6.1 railway correction.

items.title: Sources and reuse
items.description: Citations, source dates, provider conditions and redistribution notes. Each component retains its own terms.

items.title: File checksums
items.description: SHA-256 fingerprints for every published GIS file, including the three ZIP editions and the R source package.
